description.zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh-CN（默认值）：中文，en-US：英文
description.en: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh-CN and en-US. Default value: zh-CN. The value zh-CN indicates Chinese, and the value en-US indicates English.
The content of the service authentication rule.
Specifies whether to enable the rule.
The namespace ID of the Kubernetes cluster.
The service source that the application accesses.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-auth-policy --name demo-test --source edasmsc --id 432 --biz-region cn-hangzhou --enable true --app-id abcde@12345 --protocol SPRING_CLOUD --auth-rule all_:true,_appIds_:_f6xqzbao96@4adfaf3c92c947a_,_black_:false --k8s-namespace c19c6c500e1ff4d7abc7bed9b8236000 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
